title: 8.4 Unique Words
prompt: 8.4 Open the file romeo.txt and read it line by line. For each line, split the line into a list of words using split(). Build a list of unique words (append a word only if it is not already in the list). When the program completes, sort and print the resulting words. For example, the printed list should begin with ['Arise', 'But', 'It', 'Juliet', ...].

student.py.starter:
fname = input("Enter file name: ")
fh = open(fname)
lst = list()
for line in fh:
print(line.rstrip())
student.py.solution:
fname = input("Enter file name: ")
fh = open(fname)
lst = list()
for line in fh:
    words = line.split()
    for word in words:
        if word in lst: continue
        lst.append(word)
lst.sort()
print(lst)
